Class CartesianPositivePlane

java.lang.Object
jaba.cartesian.CartesianPositivePlane
public class CartesianPositivePlane extends Object
This class manages and draws points in a dimensional cartesian plane. This class draws just the first quadrant of the plane.
Author:
Sebastiano Spicuglia

      public CartesianPositivePlane(Graphics2D g, DPoint origin, int xAxisLength, int yAxisLength, double xMaxValue, double yMaxValue) throws Exception
      Creates a new CartesianPositivePlane object
      Parameters:
      g - the specified Graphics context
      origin - the point on g where to place the origin of the plane
      xAxisLength - the x-axis length
      yAxisLength - the y-axis length
      xMaxValue - the max value of abscissa you want to place on the graph
      yMaxValue - the max value of ordinate you want to place on the graph
      Throws:
      Exception
